subject: Renewal QBR: regional rehearsal lanes and backup host orchestration
messages:
From: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@healthsync.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Chen <tom.chen@healthsync.com>
Date: 2028-04-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal QBR — timing + run of show ask

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the heads-up on our renewal window. We’re planning a compact QBR the week of May 6 to align product, security, and finance. We have stakeholders in APAC and US — two live demos are required (APAC-friendly and US-friendly).

Quick asks: 
- Can Redwood run two rehearsal lanes (one APAC morning, one US morning) and provide one backup host per lane in case of conflicts?
- We’ll need a run-of-show template and a short dry-run (~30 minutes) 48–72 hours before each live demo.

Tentative attendees: myself, Tom Chen (technical lead), procurement (TBD), and our Head of Product (joining only for the APAC demo).

Attached is a first-pass agenda (QBR-agenda-v3.pdf). Can you propose times and confirm backup host options?

Best,
Alicia Turner
Customer Success, HealthSync Medical

Attachment: QBR-agenda-v3.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@healthsync.com>, Tom Chen <tom.chen@healthsync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — timing + run of show ask

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear ask and the agenda. Happy to run two rehearsal lanes and provide backup hosts. Proposed plan below: 

Option A (preferred)
- APAC rehearsal: May 6, 08:30 SGT / 01:30 UTC — 30m dry-run on May 5 08:30 SGT
- US rehearsal: May 7, 09:00 PT / 16:00 UTC — 30m dry-run on May 6 09:00 PT

Backup host approach:
- Primary host: Mina (Redwood AE)
- Backup host: Marissa (Redwood Solutions Engineer) for APAC lane if Mina is pulled to exec brief; Jonas will be on standby for technical recovery and recording handover.

I’ve attached a provisional run_of_show.xlsx with timeboxes and owner slots. If those times work, I’ll send calendar invites and Dry-Run invites and loop in our ops vendor for recording checks.

Action items:
- Alicia: confirm attendee list and any restricted compliance attendees (we’ll need to tighten recording access if procurement joins).
- Tom: confirm whether you want a deeper technical demo or a condensed tech appendix.

Thanks,
Mina
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: run_of_show.xlsx (XLSX, 18KB)

From: Tom Chen <tom.chen@healthsync.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@healthsync.com>
Date: 2028-04-04T01:17:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — timing + run of show ask

Mina / Alicia — I prefer the condensed tech appendix for the exec-facing session, but would like a 20–30 minute deep dive during the APAC rehearsal for our engineers. Can Marissa be the backup host for the technical slot specifically?

If Marissa can take the deep tech dry-run, that frees Mina to focus on the roadmap narrative for execs.

—Tom

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Tom Chen <tom.chen@healthsync.com>, Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@healthsync.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-05T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — timing + run of show ask

Happy to run the APAC technical dry-run. A couple operational notes before we lock times: 

- Recording access: if procurement joins, HealthSync will need recording ACL limited to named people only. We can host the recording in a secure bucket and add your procurement account email list. Please share the list 72 hours before the live session.
- Recovery play: Jonas and I will triage the common failures: model fallback, streaming interruption, and KV-cache warmup. Jonas will stay on the bridge during live demos and can stage an alternative model (quantized variant) within 4 minutes if needed.
- Clockwise: I’ll ping partners@clockwise.co to set the calendar blocks and confirm attendee RSVP windows; we should share a 2-hour buffer around each demo for runbooks.

If you confirm attendee ACL and the narrower tech appendix request, I’ll schedule the dry-run and add Jonas as recovery + recording owner.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@healthsync.com>, Tom Chen <tom.chen@healthsync.com>
Date: 2028-04-07T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — timing + run of show ask

All — confirming final plan and a minor slot swap request from procurement: 

Finalized schedule (locked):
- APAC live demo: May 6, 09:00 SGT (dry-run May 5, 08:30 SGT) — Marissa leads tech dry-run; Mina leads live narrative
- US live demo: May 7, 09:00 PT (dry-run May 6, 09:00 PT) — Mina leads both dry-run and live narrative; Jonas on bridge for recovery

Procurement requested the US live demo to be recorded but access-limited; Alicia — can you send the procurement ACL (emails) by 2028-05-04? If we don’t receive it, we’ll treat the recording as exec-only and share a redacted recording.

Next steps I’ll take on:
- Create runbook snippet for quick model swap (link to S3 staging and playback).
- Create calendar invites and attach run_of_show.xlsx and the shared Drive folder.

If everyone agrees I’ll publish invites and tag the events with the deal id HS-4521.

Jonas Weber
Engineer, Field Reliability — Redwood Inference
